name: University of California Irvine Division of Continuing Education
description:
The University of California, Irvine is situated in Southern California. Having been established in 1965, the university has gone on to develop a world-renowned reputation for research and attracted three Nobel Prize winners to join their faculty.

It has been ranked the 7th best public university in the United States for seven years in a row. International students from all over the world settle into University life at UCI Division of Continuing Education thanks to the warm welcome provided by its airport pickups, student wellness support, English language practice sessions and more.

University resources are plentiful at UCI Division of Continuing Education. The Career Advancement Network provides students with help throughout their studies, including workshops, webinars, 1:1 career counselling and more. The Anteater Recreation Center is a state-of-the-art sports and fitness facility located on the east-side of Campus with classes for fitness and wellness, outdoor adventures (including sailing), and other organised programs. The UCI Bookstore is called The Hill and the Langson library has comprehensive materials on a variety of disciplines for students to use. The Science and Medical libraries are situated on campus and provide a wealth of learning support materials.

Student Life

The campus is smoke and tobacco-free, gets a lot of sunshine and the laid-back atmosphere in California radiates into the University grounds. Many international students come together to celebrate cultural events, make friends and play or spectate on University sports. The international student support at UCI Division of Continuing Education is profound due to the wealth of services designed especially for students. The University came second for diversity by The Wall Street Journal/Times Higher Education.

San Pablo, California is a more suburban area that provides residents with panoramic views from the hilltops. Situated in Contra Costa County, California, the area is known for having a vibrant multicultural community and a relaxed attitude. Everything you need is close by, including food shops, shopping outlets, bars and restaurants.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
On-campus housing is available in 'dorms' that have been fully furnished, include Wi-Fi, contain modern amenities and can be either shared or private rooms. Students can socialise with other international students and get advice from American peer advisors.

There are multiple apartment options that come with facilities such as a pool, jacuzzi, volleyball courts and more. Situated in close proximity to an international grocery store, large park and shopping centre. The apartments are shared by 4 international students of the same gender in 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartments. Homestay programmes are a good idea to integrate into American culture as a local trusted family takes international students into their household.
